summary_en: 200 shares of OMT (100% acquisition, completing subsidiarity). Deal price non-disclosed per mutual agreement; below 15% of net assets threshold. Contract signed July 15, 2026; share transfer execution August 1, 2026. Funded by internal cash. FY3/27 impact negligible.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of all shares of OMT Corporation (complete subsidiary)
translation_en_brief: On July 15, 2026, Naigai Tec Corporation's board approved acquisition of all 200 outstanding shares of OMT Corporation, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. OMT, established in 2003 and headquartered in Miyagi, specializes in maintenance and overhaul of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Currently 100% held by Lapis Semiconductor, OMT generated ¥414M in revenue and ¥17M operating profit in FY3/26. The acquisition price, determined through due diligence by external advisors and bilateral negotiation, will remain undisclosed per mutual agreement and falls below the 15% net-asset threshold requiring disclosure. Contract execution and share transfer are scheduled for August 1, 2026, funded entirely by internal cash. The company states the deal will have negligible impact on FY3/27 consolidated results. Rationale centers on OMT's technical expertise in semiconductor equipment maintenance and strong synergies with Naigai Tec's strategic focus on strengthening maintenance-support services.
